## Installation

1. Download and install the [Splinter Cell: Chaos Theory Widescreen Fix](https://fusionfix.io/wfp#scct), or the required [ASI Loader](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader).
2. Download [Xbox Rain Droplets for Splinter Cell Chaos Theory](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/XboxRainDroplets/releases/download/scct/SplinterCellChaosTheory.XboxRainDroplets.zip) and put the `.asi` and `.ini` files into the `scripts` folder.
3. Launch the game - the drops of the effect are visible while it rains.

## Notes

- The ini is watched while the game runs, so its settings can be changed and tested without restarting.
